title: DesignRecipe
description: A deterministic, PARAMETRIC description of one T-shirt design — a reproducible recipe generated from rules + parameters + a seed, never a stored raster. Given the same (schemaVersion, engineVersion, grammarVersion, seed, resolved inputs) it must render byte-identically. Superset of the existing Dart DesignParams genome; the mapped subset MUST collapse to a legal DesignParams that the current renderer/print pipeline can already produce (see schemas/README.md).

recipeId.description: Stable content hash of the design. For the DesignParams-mapped subset this MUST equal DesignParams.contentHash so caches/telemetry/goldens align across the boundary.

seed.description: The deterministic driver. Every stochastic grammar choice (layout shuffle, motif pick, jitter) derives from a named sub-stream of this seed. Persisted so print == preview.

contextScopeKey.description: Opaque key identifying the DesignContext this was generated for (e.g. 'region:europe:2024'). Lets a recipe be re-resolved without embedding the whole context.

engineVersion.description: Semantic version of the runtime engine that produced/validates this recipe.

grammarVersion.description: Version of the design grammar (design_engine/grammar) used. Changing the grammar can change the meaning of a seed, so this is part of reproducibility.

composition.description: The macro layout skeleton. Maps to the core DesignParams genes.

template.description: CardTemplateType — which existing card renderer draws this.

clip.description: Optional clip/mask shape for the composition (grid template). Silhouette/outline clips are single-country only (enforced by DesignParams.normalize).

code.description: ISO-2 (country/continent outline) or silhouette slug (assets/symbols/animal_slugs.json). Required for outline/silhouette/continent shapes.

source.description: MerchCountrySource — semantic provenance of the set.

palette.description: Colour strategy. garmentColour maps to DesignParams.shirtColour today; the rest is forward-looking (currently derived inside card widgets / flag_colours).

typography.description: Title/subtitle treatment. Forward-looking: the printed STRING is generated downstream by TitleGen and is NOT part of the reproducible genome; only the treatment (style/case/placement) is.

motifs.description: Optional decorative silhouettes/landmarks/symbols layered into the composition. Forward-looking; resolved against bundled silhouette/landmark assets.

printStyle.description: The print filter applied AFTER rendering by PrintStylePipeline (downstream of the genome). Recorded here for reproducibility only.

provenance.description: How this recipe came to exist (for studio batches, telemetry, regression). Never feeds the seed.
